evidence: Skill reference quality-checks.md:44 asks for: cpus/memory_mb present and sane; no secret literal under [environment]; network_mode = "public"; [environment].docker_image absent; allow_internet omitted. task/task.toml:20-24 reads [environment] build_timeout_sec = 600.0, network_mode = "public", cpus = 2, memory_mb = 4096. The [agent]..[environment] block is byte-identical to the frozen template rules/projects/webdev-task-template/task.toml and to staged-task-contract.md:56-60. grep finds no docker_image and no allow_internet anywhere in task.toml. [environment] holds no env values at all; the only credential-shaped value in task.toml is the template's [verifier.env] ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN = "${OPENROUTER_API_KEY}" (a ${VAR} template, a known false positive, and verifier-side, not agent-side). task/environment/Dockerfile (sha256 0a75419e...67d1) is byte-identical to the template agent Dockerfile: FROM node:22-bookworm-slim; ENV NODE_PATH only (line 3); pinned global express@5.1.0 and better-sqlite3@12.4.1 (lines 9-12); COPY instructions/ and assets/; git init of /app with identity turing@local.invalid; no ARG/ENV secret, no key material. Secret scan of environment/ and the whole frozen task (provider key shapes sk-/sk-or-/sk-ant-/AKIA/ghp_/xox/AIza, PEM blocks, api_key/secret/token) found only the demo password Hireops!2026 (hireops_rules.md:11, instruction.md:17, app_context.md:8; explicitly allowed by the skill and check-no-literal-secrets.py) and session-token code in the golden app. Seed emails use only reserved-style domains hireops.example, candidates.example, mail.example; no phone/SSN patterns. Sanity of 2 CPU / 4096 MB: the agent workload is one Node 22 Express + better-sqlite3 process plus the agent's own tooling (integration.md: only those packages and Node built-ins); better-sqlite3 12.4.1 ships linux-x64 Node 22 prebuilds, fetched at build time over the public network (fetching is not a defect per quality-checks.md:45). Raw evidence (hash-verified) shows the same pinned packages run the frozen golden in the verifier image as uid 65534, consistent with these packages loading on node:22 bookworm. Counterexample probes: a broken app cannot exploit this row (it grades agent posture, not output); a conforming app is not starved, since the declared runtime is fixed to preinstalled Express/better-sqlite3 and public network allows any extra CDN/front-end fetch integration.md permits. Internal Quality Checks row 9 still says 'no-network ... nothing that secretly needs an install'; that wording is superseded by the public-network public sheet and skill Delivery profile, so network_mode = public is not flagged. Residual (not a defect, P3-level observation only): this round's raw evidence contains no build of the agent image itself, but the Dockerfile and resource block are unchanged template bytes and nothing in this row depends on a measured run.
